scope_notes: The auditor checks public request projection, sealed input-view reads, background retrieval receipts, package integrity and message phase projection. It does not supply audit findings to a learning role.

Explicit final_answer takes priority; absent final_answer the original assistant text is preserved for each existing role parser. Raw provider output and native continuation remain preserved. Reasoning items are not inspected.

A single creation client operation uses the reviewed single_post sender without automatic resend. Incomplete response or creation stages are not labelled successful. Provider-internal actions remain unobservable.
The input view contains sealed original current-task inputs, not a complete running filesystem. Acquisition sufficient is an operational judgment, not proof of document recall or task success.
Paid task scores and independent evaluation belong to separate result records; this audit does not select a package or request another sample.

limitations: Keyword coverage plus review of the relevant short task background supports this diagnosis; it is not a proof that every possible inference is unavailable.
